title: Strata History Record
description: A single persisted chat/history entry (design/03-Architecture.md ChatMessage), written and read via IHistoryStore / HistoryStore implementations.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-session ordering; store backends may not preserve insertion order on their own.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp string. See schema/README.md for why this is a string, not a typed date.
